story.soThat: I can quickly find specific partitions
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Create PartitionSearch component (AC: 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8) - 1.1 Create src/components/features/partition/PartitionSearch.tsx - 1.2 Add shadcn/ui Input component with search icon (lucide-react Search) - 1.3 Add clear button (X icon) that appears when search has text - 1.4 Implement controlled input with value from partitionStore.searchFilter - 1.5 Add onChange handler to update store with debounced value - 1.6 Display filtered count: "Showing X of Y partitions" - 1.7 Show "No results" empty state when filtered partitions = 0 - 1.8 Style with Linear Violet theme colors
- Task 2: Implement debounce utility (AC: 3) - 2.1 Create src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts hook - 2.2 Implement debounce with 200ms delay - 2.3 Use useEffect + setTimeout pattern - 2.4 Cleanup timeout on unmount or value change - 2.5 Export TypeScript-typed hook
- Task 3: Enhance partitionStore with search (AC: 2, 6) - 3.1 Add searchFilter: string to partitionStore state (ALREADY EXISTS) - 3.2 Add setSearchFilter(filter: string) action (ALREADY EXISTS) - 3.3 Add clearSearchFilter() action - 3.4 Add computed selector filteredPartitions that filters by searchFilter - 3.5 Ensure case-insensitive matching - 3.6 Optionally persist searchFilter to localStorage
- Task 4: Update PartitionGrid to use filtered partitions (AC: 2, 8) - 4.1 Import and use filteredPartitions selector instead of raw partitions (ALREADY IMPLEMENTED) - 4.2 Update partition count display to show filtered count (ALREADY IMPLEMENTED) - 4.3 Pass filtered count to PartitionSearch component - 4.4 Ensure "Select All" / "Deselect All" work with filtered partitions
- Task 5: Integrate PartitionSearch into PartitionGrid (AC: 1) - 5.1 Import PartitionSearch component - 5.2 Add PartitionSearch above the grid, in the grid header section - 5.3 Position search box to the right of "Partitions" title - 5.4 Ensure responsive layout: search box stacks on mobile
- Task 6: Add i18n translations (AC: all) - 6.1 Add English translations to src/i18n/translations/en.json - 6.2 Add Vietnamese translations to src/i18n/translations/vi.json
- Task 7: Testing and verification (AC: 1-8) - 7.1 Run npm run dev and verify no TypeScript errors - 7.2-7.8 Test all acceptance criteria

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When partitions are displayed, a search box appears above the grid AC2: Typing in search box filters partitions by name (case-insensitive) AC3: Search is debounced (200ms) to prevent excessive re-renders AC4: "No results" message shown when no partitions match search AC5: Clear button (X) resets search and shows all partitions AC6: Search filter state is stored in partitionStore AC7: Search works with Vietnamese and English characters AC8: Partition count updates to show filtered count

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: User wants to search and filter partitions to quickly find specific partitions in devices with 100+ partitions. Search should be debounced (200ms), case-insensitive, with clear button and "no results" state.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: All feature components follow standard structure: hooks at top, derived state, handlers, then render. Use cn() utility for className composition. Components should be TypeScript-typed with proper interfaces.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Stores use create() from zustand with state and actions. Use persist middleware for localStorage. Computed selectors can be implemented as functions that call get().

doc.title: Story 4.1: PartitionGrid Component
doc.snippet: PartitionGrid displays partitions in table layout. partitionStore already has searchFilter state and setSearchFilter action. PartitionGrid already filters partitions using useMemo based on searchFilter.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Product Requirements
doc.snippet: Partition operations require efficient UI for devices with 100+ partitions. Search and filter are essential for usability.

story-context.constraints: - Follow Component Pattern from architecture.md: hooks at top, derived state, handlers, render - Use TypeScript with proper interfaces for all components and hooks - Follow i18n naming convention: partition.search.{key} - Use shadcn/ui Input component (need to install if not exists) - Debounce must be 200ms to balance responsiveness with performance - Case-insensitive search using .toLowerCase() for both filter and partition name - Clear button should only appear when searchFilter has text - Empty state message when filteredPartitions.length === 0 - partitionStore already has searchFilter state - DO NOT recreate - PartitionGrid already implements filtering - only need to add PartitionSearch component - Follow Linear Violet theme colors from UX spec - Ensure responsive layout: search box stacks on mobile
